summary: Diagnosed cache invalidation failure on link mutation causing stale redirects.
evidence: Identified root cause: updateLink in link.service.ts omitted cacheService.invalidateRedirectTarget(existing.code), leaving stale public redirect keys active in Redis.
Observed symptom: PATCH /links/:id succeeded (HTTP 200), but GET /r/:code immediately returned stale URL with X-Cache: HIT.
Formulated diagnostic plan: inspect r:{code} key in Redis and restore active DEL eviction in updateLink immediately following DB transaction.
